title: Deployment Plans: Choose What to Export | Orchard Core
description:
Before content and configuration move to another site, you decide what leaves this one. A deployment plan holds that decision as a saved, named list of steps, so the same package can be built again whenever you need it.

In Orchard Core, you create a plan, add the steps that export content, content definitions, and files, put them in order, and execute the plan to download one package.

In this video:
• What a deployment plan is
• Creating a plan
• Adding steps from the available categories
• Putting the steps in order
• General-purpose steps: Custom File and Recipe File
• Executing a plan with File Download
• Searching and renaming plans, and the permissions they need
